verdicts_by_insurer.note: Policy (Sept 2024): round-trip ticket home after the death of a spouse, parent, grandparent, child, sibling or parent-in-law, or their life-threatening hospitalisation. Round trip only if the return ticket is bought with the outbound one, we fly back out within 30 days, and the contract still runs at least 1 month after; otherwise one way. Once per 12 months. €200k medical, no excess; dental €600/year; repatriation at real cost. Tourist trips only, but unpaid manual work (fruit picking, light farm work) is covered. Buy before leaving: 12-day waiting period if bought abroad.
